tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Who is using the app right now and what state it is in. Call this first in a session. Returns role ('parent' = the elderly user, 'guardian' = the adult child), how to address people (parent_honorific, guardian_title), whether settings exist, whether an order is in progress, and the current local time.

returns.parent_honorific: string used when talking about the parent, e.g. 어머님
returns.health_conditions: list of condition labels, e.g. ['혈압이 높아요']

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Menus the user can order right now, best first. Already filtered by allergies, required tags and health conditions (never relaxed). Default: the top 3 shown on the first screen. With include_more=true also returns up to 6 further menus ('다른 메뉴'). Read at most 3 menus aloud at a time.

include_more.description: Also return the '다른 메뉴' list (up to 6 more).

returns.menus: list of {menu_id, name, price, price_text (e.g. '8,500원'), category_label, reason (one easy sentence)}
returns.health_note: string, e.g. '혈압을 생각해서 싱겁게 드시도록 골랐어요', or ''
returns.disclaimer: '의사·영양사 상담을 대신하지 않아요' when health conditions are set, else ''

tools.web_ref: recommend, moreMenus, reasonFor, healthNoteText (pa1View, pamView, ch4View)

tools.name: get_menu_detail
tools.description: Details of one menu: description, price, and whether it can be ordered under the current settings. For the guardian role also nutrition values per serving with sources and the per-condition health check. Never give medical advice beyond what this returns.

returns.name: string
returns.nutrition: guardian only: list of {label, value_text} (e.g. {'나트륨', '666mg'}); unknown values are '모름'
returns.health_check: guardian only: list of {condition_label, result: 기준에 맞아요 | 기준보다 많아요 | 정보가 없어서 빼 두었어요}

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Step 1 of ordering. Checks that the menu can be ordered now and returns a confirmation_id plus the exact confirmation question to read aloud. Nothing is ordered yet. Ask the user that question with ask_user; only if they clearly agree, call place_order with the confirmation_id. As guardian this is a proxy order for the parent.

returns.confirmation_id: string, single use, expires after expires_in_sec
returns.confirm_question: string to read aloud, e.g. '전복죽, 10,000원이에요. 자녀분 카드로 결제돼요. 주문할까요?'

tools.web_ref: passesFilter, canGuardianOrder, pa2View / ch4View confirm screens

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Step 2 of ordering: places the (mock) order prepared by prepare_order. Only call after the user explicitly agreed to the confirm_question. The app re-checks every rule; orderedBy is set from the current role. The guardian's screen is notified of a parent's order and vice versa.
tools.say_example: 전복죽을 주문했어요. 오후 12시 5분쯤 도착해요. 자녀분께 알림이 가요

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: The latest order and where it is: 접수(received) → 조리중(cooking) → 배달중(delivering) → 도착(arrived), or 취소됨(cancelled). Includes who ordered it, the arrival time and whether it can still be cancelled.

returns.status_desc: easy sentence, e.g. '배달하는 분이 음식을 가지고 가고 있어요'
returns.ordered_by_text: string phrased for the current role, e.g. '따님이 주문했어요'

tools.web_ref: getLatestOrder, getStatus, STATUS_LABELS, STATUS_DESC, orderedByText, etaText, canCancel

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel the latest order. Only possible while it is still 접수(received); once cooking has started the app refuses. Pass the order_id from get_order_status so the right order is cancelled. Confirm once with ask_user before calling ('주문을 취소할까요?').

tools.name: acknowledge_arrival
tools.description: Mark the arrived order as received by the parent ('잘 받았어요'). Only after status is arrived. This closes the order so a new one can be placed.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Order history, newest first (guardian '주문 내역' tab).

returns.orders: list of {order_id, menu_name, price_text, status_label, ordered_by_text, date_text, platform_label}

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Recent notifications (guardian '알림' tab): orders placed and status changes, newest first.
tools.web_ref: CH-N (computed from orders and STATUS_TIMES_SEC, bannerText)

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Current family settings and the allowed values for each field. Address and payment are returned only as easy labels, never as raw data.

returns.options: allowed values: health_conditions[{id,label}], categories, tags, platforms[{id,label}], guardian_titles

tools.web_ref: loadSettings, HEALTH_RULES, PLATFORMS, TAG_LIST, CATEGORY_ORDER, GUARDIAN_TITLES

tools.name: prepare_settings_change
tools.description: Step 1 of changing settings. Pass only the fields to change; each list replaces the whole current list (read get_settings first and send the full new list). Returns a confirmation_id and a spoken summary of the change. Address, payment, family code and accounts cannot be changed by voice.

returns.confirmation_id: string, single use, expires after expires_in_sec
returns.confirm_question: e.g. '건강 상태에 혈당이 높아요를 더할게요. 바꿀까요?'
returns.menus_after: integer: how many menus remain orderable after the change (0 means nothing can be ordered)

tools.name: apply_settings_change
tools.description: Step 2: apply the change prepared by prepare_settings_change. Only after the guardian explicitly agreed.
tools.say_example: 설정을 바꿨어요. 이제 싱거운 음식 위주로 골라 드릴게요

tools.name: open_screen
tools.description: Show a screen so the user can see what you are talking about (e.g. after ordering, show the order status). parent screens: home, more_menus, order_status. guardian screens: home, orders, notifications, my, settings, nutrition. Prefer this over tapping through the GUI.

menu_id.description: optional: for nutrition, scroll to this menu

tools.web_ref: parent.js / child.js screen ids: pa-1, pa-m, pa-3, ch-2, ch-h, ch-n, ch-my, ch-1, ch-nutrition
